report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of daedalus/tools/inventory.py: collects MCP servers, builds inventory, renders table.
risks: collect_mcp_servers | medium | Uses _read_json and vet_mod.vet_mcp_server; errors from vet_mod.load_allowances and _read_json are appended to errors list; unspecified behavior if allowances is None or vet_mod.vet_mcp_server raises exception | Check if vet_mod.vet_mcp_server can raise exceptions and how they are handled

build | low | Uses _Shim to wrap verdict dicts; _Shim frozen dataclass with subject, outcome, cleared; assumes vet_mod.summarise accepts iterable of such objects | Verify vet_mod.summarise signature and behavior with _Shim objects
render | low | Verdict column uses v['outcome'] and v['findings']; assumptions about verdict dict keys | Ensure all verdict dicts have 'outcome', 'findings' keys

handoff.purpose: Collect MCP servers, build full inventory dict, render terminal table.

symbols.name: collect_mcp_servers
symbols.note: Reads JSON files for MCP server configurations; uses vet_mod to vet each server.

symbols.name: build
symbols.note: Top-level inventory builder; combines skills and MCP servers, sorts, returns dict with version, vet_version, root, tools, summary, errors, degraded flag.

symbols.name: _Shim
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass to wrap verdict dicts for vet_mod.summarise.

symbols.name: _summary
symbols.note: Calls vet_mod.summarise and removes 'version' from result.

symbols.name: render
symbols.note: Returns a flat table string for terminal display; includes summary and degraded status.

claims.text: The whole inventory. Deterministic: every list sorted by (kind, scope, name).
claims.why: Code does records = sorted(sk + mc, key=lambda r: (r.kind, r.scope, r.name)).

claims.text: Read errors are NEVER folded into the summary counts.
claims.why: Summary counts are computed from records (which are built from sk and mc, which only include successfully read tools). Errors are stored separately in errors list.

claims.text: "Could not read the tool list" and "there are no tools" produce the same empty list, and a caller must be able to tell them apart.
claims.why: If all reads fail, sk and mc are empty, records empty, tools empty list; errors non-empty and degraded=True. If no tools exist, errors empty and degraded=False. Caller can check degraded flag.

claims.text: A flat table for a terminal. The verdict column is the point.
claims.why: Function returns a string formatted as a table with columns including VERDICT.

claims.text: Every public symbol in the chunk gets a row.
claims.why: The instruction is meta, not in code. The symbols listed above are the public ones in this chunk (collect_mcp_servers, build, _Shim, _summary, render). Note that _Shim and _summary are private (underscore prefix).

observations.what: collect_mcp_servers uses vet_mod.load_allowances, _read_json, and vet_mod.vet_mcp_server; errors are appended to errors list; if _read_json returns error, continue; if servers not dict, continue; iterates sorted keys.
build function sorts records by (kind, scope, name) and returns dict with version, vet_version, root, include_user_scope, tools, summary, errors, degraded.
render function returns string; if no tools, returns special message with degraded info; otherwise builds table lines with headers and data.
_Shim is a frozen dataclass with subject, outcome, cleared attributes.
